cases.sentence: Я видел, как Ягненок открыл первую из семи печатей, и затем услышал, как одно из четырех ___ сказало громоподобным голосом:
cases.explain: «живых существ» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

cases.explain: «белого коня» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

cases.sentence: Когда Ягненок снял вторую печать, я услышал, как второе ___ сказало:
cases.explain: «живое существо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

cases.explain: «другой конь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Another came out: a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

cases.sentence: На нем сидел вооруженный ___ всадник, которому была дана власть лишить землю мира, чтобы люди на ней убивали друг друга.
cases.explain: «длинным мечом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Another came out: a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

cases.sentence: Когда Ягненок снял третью печать, я услышал, как третье ___ сказало:
cases.explain: «живое существо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

cases.sentence: И я услышал со стороны четырех ___ голос, говорящий:
cases.explain: «живых существ» — after the preposition «со», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix  of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

cases.explain: «мертвенно-бледного коня» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades  followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

cases.sentence: Им была дана власть над четвертой частью земли, чтобы губить людей мечом, голодом, эпидемиями и ___.
cases.explain: «дикими зверями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades  followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

cases.sentence: Каждому из них была дана ___, и им было сказано подождать еще некоторое время, пока число их сотрудников и братьев, которые будут убиты так же, как и они, не достигнет своей полноты.
cases.explain: «белая одежда» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers,  who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

cases.sentence: Тогда вдруг произошло ___ , и солнце стало черным, как рубище, а луна стала красной, как кровь .
cases.explain: «сильное землетрясение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

cases.sentence: Небесные звезды упали на землю, как ___ падает с деревьев от сильного порыва ветра .
cases.explain: «незрелый инжир» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

cases.sentence: Небесные звезды упали на землю, как незрелый инжир падает с деревьев от ___ ветра .
cases.explain: «сильного порыва» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

cases.sentence: Цари земли, ___, полководцы, богатые и власть имущие, и все люди — рабы и свободные — попрятались в пещерах и расщелинах гор .
cases.explain: «высокопоставленные чиновники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
